faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow) for filling up research positions in the Information Technology & Systems Area.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIM Lucknow?
faq.answer: IIM Lucknow has advertised for the contractual position of Senior Research Assistant through this recruitment notification released in October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Assistant position under this particular recruitment notification issued by the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Senior Research Assistant post is 30-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Management, Information Technology, Social Sciences, or related subjects along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. How much work experience is required to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants are required to have a minimum of two years of relevant post-qualification experience in order to be eligible for the Senior Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Research Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 plus HRA per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the scrutiny of all received applications followed by an online interview of the shortlisted candidates conducted by IIM Lucknow.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the official Google form provided by IIM Lucknow with all necessary details and documents.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification released by IIM Lucknow for the Senior Research Assistant post.
